title.en: Electric 15 vs the Rural Diesel Pump
title.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 15 needs the printed 15 kW motor line. The rural pump prints a 17 kW diesel engine. Distance on both pages is a range, not one ceiling.
description.zh: 电动15要看印出的 15 kW 电机行。农村泵印 17 kW 柴油机。两页距离都是范围，不是单一上限。

h1.en: Electric 15 vs the Rural Diesel Pump
h1.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 15 and the rural diesel pump are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 15 prints a 15 kW motor, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m and horizontal 60–80 m. The rural pump prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, horizontal 30–50 m and vertical 10–30 m. Aggregate is 1–3 cm on both pages.
directAnswer.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。电动15印 15 kW 电机、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。农村泵印 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m。骨料都是 1–3 cm。电动15印管径。农村页印压力 15 MPa，不印管径。

heading.en: Where Electric 15 and Rural diesel pump print different values
heading.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h; Rural diesel pump prints 5–8 m³/h. Vertical delivery height: Electric 15 prints 15–20 m; Rural diesel pump prints 10–30 m. Horizontal delivery distance: Electric 15 prints 60–80 m; Rural diesel pump prints 30–50 m. Dimensions: Electric 15 prints 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm; Rural diesel pump prints 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. Total weight: Electric 15 prints 450 kg; Rural diesel pump prints 800 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. aggregate size is 1–3 cm on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动15印 8–10 m³/h；农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。垂直输送高度：电动15印 15–20 m；农村柴油泵印 10–30 m。水平输送距离：电动15印 60–80 m；农村柴油泵印 30–50 m。外形尺寸：电动15印 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm；农村柴油泵印 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm。整机重量：电动15印 450 kg；农村柴油泵印 800 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大骨料粒径两边都是 1–3 cm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 15 prints cells that Rural diesel pump does not: Motor power 15 kW; Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm. Rural diesel pump prints cells that Electric 15 does not: Diesel engine power 17 kW; Pumping pressure 15 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.2 m³. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动15有、农村柴油泵没有的行：电机功率 15 kW；输送管内径 100–125 mm。农村柴油泵有、电动15没有的行：柴油机功率 17 kW；泵送压力 15 MPa；料斗容积 0.2 m³。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Choose by the printed power line, motor or diesel engine, and then read that page's own range. Open /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15 and /en/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/ for Rural diesel pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 先看印出的动力是电机还是柴油机，再读那一页自己的距离范围。看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/，看农村柴油泵请打开 /zh/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 15 print the same theoretical output as Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h. Rural diesel pump prints 5–8 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15印 8–10 m³/h。农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 15 print the same vertical delivery height as Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵的垂直输送高度一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 15–20 m. Rural diesel pump prints 10–30 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15印 15–20 m。农村柴油泵印 10–30 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 15 print the same horizontal delivery distance as Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵的水平输送距离一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 60–80 m. Rural diesel pump prints 30–50 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15印 60–80 m。农村柴油泵印 30–50 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is motor power missing on Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 为什么农村柴油泵没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Rural diesel pump page does not print that label. Electric 15 prints 15 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 农村柴油泵这一页没有印这个标题。电动15印的是 15 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
